title: Ticker or timer leak
summary: Creating time.Ticker or timers without stopping them when lifecycle ends.
rationale: Leaked timers keep runtime resources alive and can cause long-term memory and goroutine growth.

detection.notes: Detect time.NewTicker or NewTimer without Stop in cancellable code paths.

impact.notes: Impact increases in hot paths, large inputs, high-concurrency services, build pipelines, or repeated request paths.

remediation.guidance: Stop tickers/timers with defer or lifecycle cleanup, and drain channels where needed.
remediation.tradeoffs: Timer cleanup can be subtle; write small helper patterns and tests.
